notes: Reviewed baseline for the LangGraph RAG graph runtime: the version set and derivation that langgraph-rag.service actually executes.
scripts/langgraph-version-watch compares the LIVE runtime against this file and exits 3 (DRIFT) on any change to a key under 'expected'.

On DRIFT: run scripts/langgraph-reverify. Only if every step passes may this baseline be updated to the new values (add the new versions, env_path, env_drv and the new 'reverification' evidence), and the change committed. If any step fails, do not update the baseline — file a fix task.

'expected' holds only drift-critical values (versions + env path/derivation). 'informational' values are recorded but never fail the check: the graph source tree changes on every source edit, and a python point release already shows up as a changed env_path.
The weekly autoUpgrade (Sat 04:00 + 15min jitter, system.autoUpgrade with --refresh) may rebuild the env, so a MATCH here is only as fresh as the last check.
